speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail. Since you've had recent antibiotic treatment, were you treated for a kidney infection or urinary symptoms prior to this? Also, have you noticed any blood in your urine or chills?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Blood Cultures. Have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, or difficulty urinating alongside the fever and flank pain?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Leukocyturia: Present, Bacterial_Culture: Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel’s_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to recent antibiotic treatment.
